political_basis.subject: Texas public contracts require an Israel-boycott certification
political_basis.real_hook: An El Paso school construction contract implements Texas Government Code Chapter 2271: a contractor with at least ten full-time employees and a contract worth at least $100,000 certifies it does not and will not boycott Israel during the agreement. Sole proprietorships are excluded.
political_basis.factual_limits: Do not apply this certification to the road crew's casual work, an individual purchase, every contractor or every small business. The fiction can involve a qualifying local company with a public contract. No claim that criticism itself is a criminal offense or that all forms of boycott are banned.
